name: service-monitor
description: Fibbee DrinkX service monitor for field engineers (Windows + macOS)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @service-monitor/core && npm run build -w @service-monitor/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @service-monitor/core && npm run dev -w @service-monitor/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build -w @service-monitor/core && npm run dist -w @service-monitor/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build -w @service-monitor/core && npm run dist:win -w @service-monitor/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build -w @service-monitor/core && npm run dist:mac -w @service-monitor/desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build -w @service-monitor/core && npm run dist:linux -w @service-monitor/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @service-monitor/core && npm run test -w @service-monitor/desktop
scripts.test:guard: npm run test && npm run typecheck -w @service-monitor/core
